title: Excel for the Sciences
description: This course provides an introduction to Microsoft Excel with specific emphasis on applications to data science, chemistry, and engineering. The instructor provides relevant course materials and lecture notes for students. No textbook is recommended or required.
outcomes: Use Excel to solve appropriate applications in Data Science, Chemistry and Engineering.
assignments: Readings as recommended by instructor from online journals and sources
Use Excel to solve a given application in each of the following areas: Data
Science, Engineering, and Chemistry. For example, students will be given a set of
data and need to describe the data numerically and graphically.
